backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing the latest app idea and exposing submit and query methods with simple validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product requirements to involved files, components, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme definitions using warm OKLCH colors for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React entrypoint and root container.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders the LandingPage.
Guided form component collecting app idea details with validation and UI controls.
frontend/src/components/IdeaSummary.tsx: Displays a styled summary of a saved app idea with optional editing action.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing the backend canister actor based on user identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLatestAppIdea.ts: React Query hook fetching and decoding the latest stored app idea, handling empty state.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitAppIdea.ts: React Query mutation hook encoding and submitting app ideas, then refreshing the latest idea cache.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and OKLCH CSS variables for light/dark themes and applies global styles.
frontend/src/lib/appIdeaEncoding.ts: Provides helpers to encode form data into a backend AppIdea object and decode it back safely.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the landing page with idea form submission, loading previous ideas, and showing a summary.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radius, typography, plugins, and OKLCH-based theme extensions.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, implemented features, and project state configuration.
